title: Slayer of Raktabīja
translation: O Goddess who slew Raktabīja, destroyer of Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa! Give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies.
translation_hi: हे रक्तबीज का वध करने वाली, चंड और मुंड का विनाश करने वाली देवी। मुझे रूप दीजिए, जय दीजिए, यश दीजिए, शत्रुओं का नाश कीजिए।

words.note: 'Blood-seed': each drop of his blood became a new demon.
Their slaying gave her the name Chāmuṇḍā.

grammar: Chāmuṇḍā: caṇḍa + muṇḍa → the name of the Goddess who killed them (chapter 7).
Refrain: रूपं देहि जयं देहि यशो देहि द्विषो जहि 'Give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies.'
